name: Shibusawa Homura
source:
2nd year high school student. The protagonist's classmate.
A shinigami that works for the 'Yomi' company.
He hates humans and became a shinigami because it would allow him to kill them.
An arrogant guy, but he can be kind to the people he likes like the protagonist.
He's a fire monster type youkai so he's good at using flames, however he is also weak to water and he loses all power when he gets wet.
